entries.name: G0A.WORDS
entries.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
entries.note: split a String on spaces, dropping empty pieces

entries.name: G0B.SPACED
entries.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
entries.note: Vector of Strings joined with single spaces

entries.name: G0A.ARGMAX
entries.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
entries.note: index of the largest number in a Vector, first on ties

entries.name: G0A.TOPKEY
entries.body: 'TK' BIND TK KEYS TK VALUES G0A.ARGMAX GET
entries.note: key of a Record whose numeric value is largest, first on ties

entries.name: G0A.SUM
entries.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
entries.note: sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for empty)

entries.name: O1B.RED
entries.body: '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
entries.note: one pass deleting adjacent () and [] pairs from a bracket String

entries.name: G0B.CAP
entries.body: CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
entries.note: upper-case the first letter of a String

entries.name: G0A.MEAN
entries.body: 'MV' BIND MV G0A.SUM MV LENGTH DIV
entries.note: arithmetic mean of a Vector

entries.name: O1A.RSTEP
entries.body: 'RX' BIND 'RA' BIND RA -1 DROP RX RA -1 GET 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT RA RX 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 RA -1 GET 0 GET RX EQ SELECT GET
entries.note: FOLD step for run-length encoding: extend the last [ value count ] pair or append [ x 1 ]

entries.name: O1A.RLE
entries.body: [ [ 1/2 0 ] ] [ O1A.RSTEP ] FOLD 1 DROP
entries.note: Vector of integers to its run-length encoding [ [ value count ] ... ]

entries.name: O1C.SHIFT
entries.body: 'X' BIND 1 COLLECT X X LENGTH 1 SUB TAKE CONCAT
entries.note: s X to the Vector [ s ] followed by X without its last element (each element's predecessor).

entries.name: G0D.MAXV
entries.body: SORT -1 GET
entries.note: Largest element of a Vector of numbers or Strings.

entries.name: G0C.MAXV
entries.body: 'LX' BIND LX LX 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
entries.note: Largest element of a non-empty numeric Vector.

entries.name: O1A.BSTEP
entries.body: 'QC' BIND 'QA' BIND QA CHARS -1 DROP JOIN QA QC 2 COLLECT JOIN QA CHARS -1 GET [ '(' ')' '[' ']' ] [ '?' '(' '?' '[' ] RECORD QC GET EQ SELECT
entries.note: FOLD/SCAN step over a '.'-based bracket stack String: pop on a matching close, else push the char

entries.name: O1C.PREV
entries.body: 'X' BIND X 0 GET X O1C.SHIFT
entries.note: Vector to the predecessor of each position; the first position is its own predecessor.

entries.name: O1D.BSTEP
entries.body: 'C' BIND 'S' BIND S CHARS 'A' BIND A -1 GET C 2 COLLECT JOIN 'P' BIND A -1 DROP JOIN S C 2 COLLECT JOIN 2 COLLECT 0 1 P '()' EQ NOT P '[]' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT GET
entries.note: FOLD/SCAN step [stack char]: pops the stack String's last char when it pairs with the char ('()' or '[]'), else appends the char

entries.name: O1D.PRESENT
entries.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
entries.note: the non-NIL elements of a Vector, in order

entries.name: O1A.DELTA1
entries.body: 'DC' BIND [ '(' ')' '[' ']' ] [ 1 -1 1 -1 ] RECORD DC GET
entries.note: one bracket character to +1 (opening) or -1 (closing)

entries.name: O1A.DELTAS
entries.body: CHARS [ O1A.DELTA1 ] MAP
entries.note: bracket String to its Vector of +1/-1 steps (empty for '')

entries.name: G0B.COUNT
entries.body: NOT [ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH
entries.note: number of TRUE lanes in a Vector of truths

entries.name: O1A.BREDUCE
entries.body: CHARS '.' [ O1A.BSTEP ] FOLD
entries.note: bracket String to '.' followed by what remains after deleting matched pairs

entries.name: O1B.REDALL
entries.body: O1B.RED O1B.RED O1B.RED O1B.RED O1B.RED O1B.RED
entries.note: reduce a bracket String of at most 12 characters to its unmatched remainder

entries.name: O1B.BAL
entries.body: O1B.REDALL '' EQ
entries.note: TRUE when a bracket String (at most 12 chars) is balanced

entries.name: O1B.RUNS
entries.body: 'RV' BIND RV 0 GET 1 ADD 1 COLLECT RV CONCAT -1 DROP 'RB' BIND RV RB SUB 'RD' BIND RD RD MUL 1 MIN 0 [ ADD ] SCAN RV GROUP VALUES
entries.note: Vector of integers to Vector of its maximal runs of equal adjacent values, each a Vector

entries.name: O1B.MISSING
entries.body: [ NIL? 'MX' BIND 1 0 MX SELECT ] MAP
entries.note: Vector with NILs to Vector of 1 for each NIL lane and 0 for each present lane

entries.name: O1C.RUNIDS
entries.body: 'X' BIND X X O1C.PREV SUB [ 'D' BIND 1 0 D 0 EQ NOT SELECT ] MAP 0 1 PUT 0 [ ADD ] SCAN
entries.note: Vector to the 1-based index of the maximal run of equal adjacent values each position belongs to.

entries.name: O1D.BREDUCE
entries.body: CHARS '.' [ O1D.BSTEP ] FOLD
entries.note: bracket String reduced by deleting adjacent matched pairs, with a leading '.' sentinel ('.' alone means balanced)

entries.name: O1D.RLESTEP
entries.body: 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 GET 'P' BIND A -1 DROP P 0 GET P 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT A E 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 P 0 GET E EQ SELECT GET
entries.note: FOLD step [runs elem] over a non-empty Vector of [value count] pairs: bumps the last count when its value equals elem, else appends [elem 1]

entries.name: O1D.NILFLAGS
entries.body: [ NIL? ] MAP
entries.note: Vector of truths: TRUE where the element is NIL

entries.name: O1D.GAPS
entries.body: O1D.NILFLAGS 'F' BIND F FALSE 1 COLLECT F -1 DROP CONCAT NOT AND G0B.COUNT
entries.note: number of runs of consecutive NILs in a Vector

entries.name: O1A.USTEP
entries.body: 'UX' BIND 'UA' BIND UX UA 1 GET 1 ADD 1 UX UA 0 GET GT SELECT 2 COLLECT
entries.note: SCAN step over [ prev len ]: len+1 when x > prev, else 1

entries.name: O1A.FSTEP
entries.body: 'FX' BIND 'FA' BIND FA FX FX NIL? SELECT
entries.note: SCAN step for forward fill: the element, or the accumulator when the element is NIL

entries.name: O1A.RUNSTEP
entries.body: 'KT' BIND 'KA' BIND KA 1 ADD 0 KT SELECT
entries.note: SCAN step over truths: current run length of TRUE (acc+1 or 0)

entries.name: O1A.RATSTEP
entries.body: 'TX' BIND 'TA' BIND TA 0 GET 'TP' BIND TX TX TP DIV NIL TX NIL? NOT TP NIL? NOT AND SELECT 2 COLLECT
entries.note: SCAN step over [ prev ratio ]: [ x x/prev ], ratio NIL when either is NIL

entries.name: O1B.BALPRE
entries.body: 'BS' BIND 0 BS CHARS LENGTH RANGE 'BR' BIND BR 0 BR [ 'BK' BIND BS CHARS BK TAKE JOIN O1B.BAL ] MAP SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
entries.note: length of the longest balanced prefix of a bracket String

entries.name: O1C.DELTA
entries.body: 'C' BIND 1 -1 '([' C SEARCH NIL? NOT SELECT
entries.note: Bracket character string to 1 when it opens a bracket, -1 when it closes one.

entries.name: O1D.BDELTAS
entries.body: CHARS [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD 'BR' BIND [ 'BC' BIND BR BC GET ] MAP
entries.note: bracket String to a Vector of +1 per opener and -1 per closer

entries.name: O1D.BDEPTH
entries.body: O1D.BDELTAS 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 1 COLLECT CONCAT G0D.MAXV
entries.note: greatest nesting depth of a bracket String (0 for empty)

entries.name: O1D.BPREFIX
entries.body: CHARS 'CS' BIND 0 CS LENGTH RANGE '.' 1 COLLECT CS '.' [ O1D.BSTEP ] SCAN CONCAT 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET '.' EQ ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP -1 GET
entries.note: length of the longest balanced prefix of a bracket String (0 when only the empty prefix is)

entries.name: O1D.UPRUNS
entries.body: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP GT 1 [ 'T' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 1 T SELECT ] SCAN 1 1 COLLECT CONCAT G0D.MAXV
entries.note: length of the longest strictly increasing stretch of adjacent values (1 for a single value)

entries.name: O1D.MAJORITY
entries.body: 'V' BIND V TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 2 MUL V LENGTH GT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP 0 GET
entries.note: the value occurring in more than half the positions, or NIL when none does

entries.name: O1D.RATIO
entries.body: [ 'P' 'C' ] BIND NIL 1 C C NIL? SELECT 1 P P NIL? SELECT DIV P NIL? NOT C NIL? NOT AND NOT SELECT
entries.note: pair [prev cur] to cur divided by prev, or NIL when either is NIL

entries.name: O1D.RATIOS
entries.body: 'V' BIND V -1 DROP V 1 DROP 2 COLLECT ZIP [ O1D.RATIO ] MAP
entries.note: each element divided by the one before it (NIL where either is NIL); one shorter than the input

entries.name: O1D.SCALED
entries.body: 'V' BIND V O1D.PRESENT G0D.MAXV 'M' BIND V [ 'X' BIND NIL 0 X X NIL? SELECT M DIV X NIL? SELECT ] MAP
entries.note: each present element divided by the largest present element; NILs stay NIL
